card.name: Punctuation and links in imaging dosing text
card.fires_on: Small connecting tokens (semicolon, comma, space, 'on', 'per', possessive 's) in imaging-agent dosing and radiation passages, just before the next dose or technique term.

modes.label: Punctuation after a clause
modes.description: A semicolon or comma ends a clause in radiation or dosing-factor text.

modes.label: Linking words before dose basis
modes.description: Words like 'on' or 'per' lead into body weight or injected activity.
modes.example: the recommended dosage is based<< on>> body weight and is administered two or three

modes.label: Spaces and units in dose ranges
modes.description: A space or unit follows a number in dose lists.

card.plain: It marks small joining spots in contrast-agent and radiotracer dosing text where a measurement or factor comes next.
